00017 BOOL CLogicMap::AddObject( CMapObject * pObject )
00018 {
00019         xListHost<CMapObject>::xListNode/*<CMapObject>*/ * pNode = NULL;
00020         if( pObject == NULL || (pNode = pObject->GetLinkNode(LNI_MAP)) == NULL )return FALSE;
00021         //      ÒÑ¾­ÊÇ³ÉÔ±ÁË£¬¾Í²»ÐèÒªÔÙ¼ÓÈëÁË
00022         if(pNode->BelongTo( &m_xObjList ) )return FALSE;
00023         //      Ö´ÐÐ¼ÓÈë
00024         if( !m_xObjList.addNode(pNode) )return FALSE;
00025         int x = pObject->getX();
00026         int y = pObject->getY();
00027         CVArea * pArea = GetArea(x,y);
00028         if( !pArea->AddObject(pObject) )
00029         {
00030                 m_xObjList.removeNode(pNode);
00031                 return FALSE;
00032         }
00033         pObject->OnEnterMap( this, pArea );
00034         return TRUE;
00035 }

00060 BOOL CLogicMap::InitAreas()
00061 {
00062         assert( m_pPhysicsMap!=NULL );
00063         assert( m_iWidth != 0 );
00064         assert( m_iHeight != 0 );
00065         assert( m_iAreaBlockWidth != 0 );
00066         assert( m_iAreaBlockHeight != 0 );
00067 
00068 
00069         m_iAreaWidth = (m_iWidth + m_iAreaBlockWidth -1)/m_iAreaBlockWidth;
00070         m_iAreaHeight = (m_iHeight + m_iAreaBlockHeight -1)/m_iAreaBlockHeight;
00071 
00072         int     i = 0,j = 0;
00073         
00074         m_pAreas = new CArea *[m_iAreaWidth];
00075         
00076         for( i = 0;i < m_iAreaWidth; i ++ )
00077         {
00078                 m_pAreas[i] = new CArea[m_iAreaHeight];
00079                 for( j = 0;j < m_iAreaHeight; j ++ )
00080                 {
00081                         m_pAreas[i][j].SetMap(this);
00082                 }
00083         }
00084         
00085         for( i = 0;i < m_iAreaWidth;i ++ )
00086         {
00087                 for( j = 0;j < m_iAreaHeight; j ++ )
00088                 {
00089                         for( int d = 0;d < 8;d ++ )
00090                         {
00091                                 int x = i, y = j;
00092                                 GETNEXTPOS( x,y, d );
00093                                 m_pAreas[i][j].SetAroundArea(d,GetAreaByAreaPos(x,y));
00094 
00095                         }
00096                         m_pAreas[i][j].SetAreaInfo( j * m_iAreaWidth + i , i, j );
00097                 }
00098         }
00099 
00100         return TRUE;
00101 }

00136 BOOL CLogicMap::SendMsg( CMapObject * pSender, const char * pszCodedMsg, int size )
00137 {
00138         xListHost<CMapObject>::xListNode/*<CMapObject>*/ * pNode = NULL;
00139 
00140         for( pNode = m_xObjList.getHead(); pNode != NULL; pNode = pNode->getNext())
00141         {
00142                 CMapObject * pObj = pNode->getObject();
00143                 if( pObj->CanRecvMsg() && pObj != pSender )
00144                         pObj->OnAroundMsg( pSender, pszCodedMsg, size );
00145         }
00146         return TRUE;
00147 }

00157 BOOL CLogicMap::LoadMap( const char * pszFilename )
00158 {
00159         m_DataFile.Open( pszFilename );
00160         //      read physics map name
00161         char * pszPhysicsMapName = (char*)m_DataFile.GetString("define", "blockmap", NULL );
00162         m_pName = (char*)m_DataFile.GetString( "define", "name", "NoName" );
00163         m_iAreaBlockWidth = m_DataFile.GetInteger( "define", "areawidth", MAP_AREA_WIDTH );
00164         m_iAreaBlockHeight = m_DataFile.GetInteger( "define", "areaheight", MAP_AREA_HEIGHT );
00165 
00166 
00167         if( pszPhysicsMapName == NULL )
00168         {
00169                 m_DataFile.Close();
00170                 return FALSE;
00171         }
00172         //      find physics map from game world 's  physicsmap manager
00173         CVPhysicsMap * pPhysicsMap = CPhysicsMapMgr::GetInstance()->GetPhysicsMapByName( pszPhysicsMapName );
00174         //      if ! found return FALSE
00175         if( pPhysicsMap == NULL )
00176         {
00177                 m_DataFile.Close();
00178                 return FALSE;
00179         }
00180         //      SetPhysicsMap( physicsmap )
00181         SetPhysicsMap( pPhysicsMap );
00182         //      Init areas
00183         if( !InitAreas() )return FALSE;
00184         //      ok~ let's successed return TRUE
00185         return TRUE;
00186 }
